title: Re-add StudyActivityChart with proper webpack config
body: The chart was removed because recharts@3.x pulls in @napi-rs/canvas (native Node.js binary) through victory-vendor, causing webpack browser build failures. The canvas issue is now properly handled by: (1) '@napi-rs/canvas' as a webpack string external (not regex), (2) '\.node$' resolve.alias to empty stub, (3) '^node:(.*)$' resolve.alias for node: protocol imports. If recharts is needed in a future PR, re-add it to package.json and test the build.
rationale: The stats page chart is a valuable UX feature that was in task 2447. It should be re-implemented properly in a follow-up PR.
